honor: Commander of the Legion of Honour (Commandeur de la Légion d'honneur)
detail: Promoted to Commander by exceptional promotion, decree of 29 January 2025. Previously made Officer of the Legion of Honour on 1 July 2021.

honor: Officer of the National Order of Merit (Officier de l'Ordre national du Mérite)
detail: Promoted to Officer of the Ordre national du Mérite by decree of 15 May 2015 (published JO 16 May 2015).

honor: Honour Medal of the National Police, Gold (Médaille d'honneur de la police nationale, échelon or)
detail: Awarded the gold-grade Honour Medal of the National Police, per the Bulletin officiel des décorations No. 06 of 9 December 2024.

honor: Order of the Aztec Eagle (Insignia rank)
detail: Awarded by Mexico on 26 September 2016, among 31 French citizens honoured (Official Journal of the Federation, Mexico).
